subject: Economics
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Statistical Tools and Interpretation in CBSE Class 11 Economics.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Economics (030), Unit-3: Statistical Tools and Interpretation covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
